title: Liquid Talkbox Solo
description: A sawtooth talkbox-style formant lead that glides through vowel shapes on a slow clock, singing legato melodies in a mid register. Vibrato warble, band-pass sweep, and a wandering pan LFO ride mutually-prime clocks so the loop stays alive across a 24-cycle arc — like a human voice filtered through a talk-box solo.
code:
setcpm(95/4)
stack(
  note("<c4 e4 g4 <a4 f4>>/2").s("sawtooth")
    .vowel("<a o u e i>/4")
    .vib(3.5).vibmod(sine.slow(13).range(0.3, 1.8))
    .bpf(sine.slow(17).range(500, 3400)).resonance(sine.slow(24).range(6, 16))
    .lpf(sine.slow(7).range(1800, 5200))
    .pan(sine.slow(11).range(0.2, 0.8))
    .attack(0.12).decay(0.3).sustain(0.75).release(0.4)
    .shape(0.2)
    .off(0.01, x => x.add(note(0.12)).gain(0.35).pan(0.7))
    .delay("0.45:0.375:0.65").room(0.6)
    .gain(0.78)
)
